  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 1 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, combine heavy cream and vanilla extract.
  6. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients, stirring just until combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and shape into an 8-inch circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Cool slightly before serving.

data.content:
Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minCook Time: 20 minServings: 8

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or two forks until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Let cool on wire rack before serving.

Chef's Notes

For best results, handle the dough as little as possible to keep scones tender. Frozen blueberries can be used if fresh are not available.

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minCook Time: 20 minServings: 8

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or two forks until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Let cool on wire rack before serving.

Chef's Notes

For best results, handle the dough as little as possible to keep scones tender. Frozen blueberries can be used if fresh are not available.

data.page_content:
Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 min | Cook time: 20 min | Servings: 8

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream, plus more for brushing
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or two forks until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and shape into an 8-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Brush tops with heavy cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  11. Cool on wire rack before serving.

Tips & Variations

  • For best results, keep butter and cream cold until ready to use.
  • Can substitute frozen blueberries - do not thaw before using.
  • Add lemon zest for a citrus twist.
  • Drizzle with lemon glaze after cooling if desired.

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minCook Time: 20 minServings: 8

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or two forks until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Let cool on wire rack before serving.

Chef's Notes

For best results, handle the dough as little as possible to keep scones tender. Frozen blueberries can be used if fresh are not available.

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minCook Time: 20 minServings: 8

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or two forks until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Let cool on wire rack before serving.

Chef's Notes

For best results, handle the dough as little as possible to keep scones tender. Frozen blueberries can be used if fresh are not available.

*   KR2.2: Expand into 2 new geographic markets (EMEA & APAC) with localized sales teams.
*   KR2.3: Secure 5 new enterprise-level contracts (ARR > $500k).

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minCook Time: 20 minServings: 8

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or two forks until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Let cool on wire rack before serving.

Chef's Notes

For best results, handle the dough as little as possible to keep scones tender. Frozen blueberries can be used if fresh are not available.

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minCook Time: 20 minServings: 8

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or two forks until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Let cool on wire rack before serving.

Chef's Notes

For best results, handle the dough as little as possible to keep scones tender. Frozen blueberries can be used if fresh are not available.

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minCook Time: 20 minServings: 8

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or two forks until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Let cool on wire rack before serving.

Chef's Notes

For best results, handle the dough as little as possible to keep scones tender. Frozen blueberries can be used if fresh are not available.

Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minutesCook Time: 20 minutesServes: 8

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 1 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, combine heavy cream and vanilla extract.
  6. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients, stirring just until combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and shape into an 8-inch circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Cool slightly before serving.

  6. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients, stirring just until combined.

  10. Cool slightly before serving.

data.page_content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cook Time: 20 minutes
Total Time: 35 minutes
Servings: 8 scones

Ingredients:
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tablespoon baking powder
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
- 1 cup fresh blueberries
- 1 large egg
- 1/2 cup heavy cream, plus extra for brushing
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- Coarse sugar for sprinkling

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, heavy cream, and vanilla extract.
6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
7. Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface and shape into a 7-inch circle.
8. Cut into 8 wedges and transfer to prepared baking sheet.
9. Brush tops with heavy cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
10. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
11. Cool on wire rack for 10 minutes before serving.

Tips:
- Keep butter and cream cold for flaky scones
- Don't overmix the dough
- Fresh or frozen blueberries work well
- Serve with clotted cream or lemon curd

Nutritional Information (per scone):
Calories: 280 | Fat: 14g | Carbs: 34g | Protein: 4g

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minCook Time: 20 minServings: 8

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or two forks until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Let cool on wire rack before serving.

Chef's Notes

For best results, handle the dough as little as possible to keep scones tender. Frozen blueberries can be used if fresh are not available.

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minCook Time: 20 minServings: 8

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or two forks until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Let cool on wire rack before serving.

Chef's Notes

For best results, handle the dough as little as possible to keep scones tender. Frozen blueberries can be used if fresh are not available.

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minCook Time: 20 minServings: 8

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or two forks until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Let cool on wire rack before serving.

Chef's Notes

For best results, handle the dough as little as possible to keep scones tender. Frozen blueberries can be used if fresh are not available.

Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minutesCook Time: 20 minutesServes: 8

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 1 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, combine heavy cream and vanilla extract.
  6. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients, stirring just until combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and shape into an 8-inch circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Cool slightly before serving.

data.page_content_preview:
...

Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minutesCook Time: 20 minutesServes: 8

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 1 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, combine heavy cream and vanilla extract.
  6. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients, stirring just until combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and shape into an 8-inch circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Cool slightly before serving.

...

Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minutesCook Time: 20 minutesServes: 8

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 1 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, combine heavy cream and vanilla extract.
  6. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients, stirring just until combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and shape into an 8-inch circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Cool slightly before serving.

Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minutesCook Time: 20 minutesServes: 8

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 1 cup heavy cream
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, combine heavy cream and vanilla extract.
  6. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients, stirring just until combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and shape into an 8-inch circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Cool slightly before serving.
